purpose: Represents a person, agency, or service with an image, initials, or icon.

notes: Provider language controls English or Dhivehi initials formatting.

useWhen: A compact visual identity is needed for a person, agency, or service.

avoidWhen.situation: The identity must be conveyed by text alone.
avoidWhen.guidance: Render the full name or label adjacent to the avatar.

approvedPatterns: Provide an image with meaningful alternative text.
Provide a full name or initials when an image is unavailable.
Use the agency icon for agency identities.
limitations: The component is presentational and has no built-in action.
Failed images fall back to initials when supplied, otherwise an icon.
accessibility: Provide a meaningful alt value for image avatars.
Initials and icons expose an accessible identity label while decorative glyphs are hidden.
responsive: Avatar dimensions are fixed by the selected design-system size.
rtl: Dhivehi names use provider-aware Thaana initials formatting.
